title: Projects & Programs
summary: AMP India Foundation runs education, employment, medical, empowerment, mentorship, and training initiatives for underprivileged youth and communities.

flagship.name: ACE - Academy for Competitive Exams
flagship.description: Premium coaching and mentorship for competitive exam aspirants.

flagship.name: AMP Employment Assistance Cell
flagship.description: Connecting skilled youth with employers through training and job fairs.

flagship.name: National Talent Search (NTS)
flagship.description: Identifying and nurturing talented students across India.

flagship.name: AMP Higher Education Scholarship
flagship.description: Scholarships enabling meritorious students to pursue higher education.

initiatives.name: Education & Vocational Skills
initiatives.description: Vocational skill programs for BPL youth including trades such as mobile repair, AC/fridge servicing, water filter systems, and vehicle-related skills, with NSDC and CSR partnerships.

initiatives.name: Medical Projects
initiatives.description: Diagnostic camps, free medicine clinics, and emergency tertiary-care funding for underserved communities.

initiatives.name: Employment Programs
initiatives.description: Soft-skills training, employability seminars, and job drives/fairs connecting youth with employers.

initiatives.name: Women Empowerment & Livelihoods
initiatives.description: Livelihood assistance, capital guidance, and self-help group (SHG) support for economic empowerment.

initiatives.name: Youth Mentorship
initiatives.description: Corporate professionals mentoring first-generation students through academic and career pathways.

initiatives.name: Employability Training Programme (ETP)
initiatives.description: Resume building, interview preparation, grooming, and communication skills for job readiness.
